title: Cosmic Sorcerer Ritual
description: A white-haired, dark-skinned sorcerer in a black coat stands behind a podium holding a glowing orb and a golden object. Surrounding him are multiple glass domes containing a purple octopus, floating planets, red spheres, and green glowing human faces, set against a dramatic purple and green cosmic background with lightning, clouds, and floating figures.
prompt: A dramatic surreal fantasy scene featuring a white-haired dark-skinned sorcerer with glowing eyes standing at a black podium, wearing a long black coat and holding a small glowing orb in one hand and a golden artifact in the other. Multiple glass domes and orbs float around him containing a purple octopus with yellow eyes, red planets, green glowing faces, and cosmic scenes. Dramatic purple and yellow clouds with golden lightning bolts raining down from above, swirling green and purple patterns on the ground, small silhouetted figures walking in the background, intricate line art details with a mystical and otherworldly atmosphere.
